title: Add HTML formatting helpers to Rust file-processor library
description: Brownfield Rust task: add an html_fmt module with error/result HTML renderers to the existing file-processor library.

task_spec.prompt:
Add a pub mod html_fmt block inside src/lib.rs with two public functions. All 7 existing tests must still pass. pub fn format_error_html(e: &dyn std::error::Error) -> String — returns:
Error: {message}
— message is e.to_string() pub fn format_result_html(r: &Result>) -> String — Ok(val) →
OK: {val}
— Err(e) → delegates to format_error_html(e.as_ref()) Do not add any new files; add the module inline in src/lib.rs. All 7 existing tests must still pass. Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: format_error_html returns div with class='error' and the error message
format_result_html returns div with class='ok' and value for Ok variant
format_result_html delegates to format_error_html for Err variant
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `cargo test` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
